mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% are not negative (i.e., positive or zero).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (indicating labor market weakness) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline are not negative (i.e., positive or zero).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (as indicated by GDP growth above 2.5% and housing starts above 1,400,000 units), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation, leading to negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion (GDPC1>2.5% and HOUST>1400) are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates strong manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO rises are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when UNRATE > 4.5% are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS>4.5% and CPIAUCSL>3.0%) are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales index (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when RSAFS rises are not positive.
